items.title: Mizuho is bullish on Broadcom ahead of Sept. 2 earnings, citing 30-quarter streak
items.summary: Klein's bullish thesis rests on a convergence of deeply negative sentiment, a near-unbroken historical earnings track record, and an expectation that CEO Hock Tan will directly confront the dominant bear narrative on the call. Broadcom is the most direct publicly traded expression of the custom ASIC AI chip debate — the market's current verdict on whether Google's in-house chip development will erode AVGO's hyperscaler revenue is weighing visibly on the stock.

items.title: Intel's Comeback Is Being Paid For By Intel
items.summary: Intel's factories are still losing money on wafers they mostly sell to Intel, and the stock's multiple likely assumes that changes.

items.title: Does Nvidia or Broadcom Have The Greater Core Vulnerability?
items.summary: Nvidia and Broadcom both rode the AI infrastructure wave to record quarters, but reading their earnings calls back-to-back exposes two very different bets investors are quietly underwriting. One faces a threat from its own best customers.

items.title: What Makes Marvell Technology So Irresistible Now
items.summary: Every quarter, one semiconductor company keeps outgrowing its own guidance while quietly locking in partnerships that look less like vendor contracts and more like infrastructure ownership. Here is why the buy button stays warm.

items.title: AI Chips Today - AI and 5G Transforming the Semiconductor Industry
items.summary: The global chipset industry is experiencing a significant transformation as artificial intelligence (AI) integrates with 5G technology, leading to an unprecedented wave of investment and innovation. With AI spending surpassing $300 billion and projected to potentially reach $1 trillion annually by 2029, strategic investments in AI-native 5G chips and advanced process nodes are accelerating. items.title: Broadcom Built Something Nearly Perfect So I Keep Buying
items.summary: Hock Tan engineered a semiconductor company that profits whether hyperscalers bet on GPUs or custom silicon, and the demand already booked stretches years into the future. Here is why that structure keeps pulling me back to the buy button.
